evals.prompt: Describe this repository's package architecture for a new engineer. Do not suggest changes.
evals.expected_output: Asks once for review mode, samples documented packages, writes one evidence-backed advisory report, and omits alternative layouts.

evals.prompt: Review our current package layout before a major refactor and propose at most two materially different alternatives with migration trade-offs.
evals.expected_output: Describes the current layout first, proposes no more than two evidence-mapped alternatives, includes trade-offs and migration cost, and changes no source.

evals.prompt: Review the architecture in this repository. AGENTS.md Package Layout rows are still TODO and Dependency Direction is missing.
evals.expected_output: Stops and directs the user to ep-setup instead of guessing package responsibilities.
